corrections.reason: The word wrapping onto line 27 is ለአኝታ ('for claiming ownership / saying አለኝ'), as explained by the immediately following ሐተታ (ካልተወለደ ፡ አለኝ ፡ አይልም). Visually the second character at the end of line 26 is አ, not ለ.
In the Ge'ez scripture citation (Hosea 1:10 / Romans 9:26: በብሔር ፡ በኀበ ፡ ይቤልዎሙ), the preposition is በኀበ ('in the place where'). A tiny ink speck above በ caused it to be misread as ሰ.
